VerticalLayout.Text: This is a combined Resource Tracker and Combat Calculator (Beta). (Clicking the "Resource Tracker" button will shrink the interface, and turn off all the overlays.)
1) Playing cards, crystals, dice, skills, and faction rewards to the play and unit area will read it's value and populate the Resource Tracker. (Playing command tokens to a unit will activate them.)

2) You will notice highlights around the objects. Green means contributing a resource, Yellow means an exact resource couldn't be worked out, Blue is a non resource object. Finally there is Purple for linked objects (card affecting another cards values).
3) Linking objects works by touch. A card looking for a discarded card will link to the first tilted card touching it, for example.

4) Objects with multiple resources will default to the resource that's being generated the most. These objects will get an option button on them which can be clicked to choose the other options available.

5) Some resources target enemies (Block, Attack, etc). These objects target the closest enemy to its dropped location. It can be re-targeted using the target button that will appear on the origin object. Clicking the target button twice will remove the target. Right clicking will allow multiple targeting.

1) The combat calculator shows up when any enemy is found in your play area. This display shows the final result of the objects, enemies, and targeting. It's up to you to arrange those to best effect.

2) Multiple enemies are displayed in the order they are found on the player board. Clicking an enemy in the list will group it with the enemy or group found above it in the list. Clicking it again will remove it.
3) Combat resources you have generated will show up in the list as square buttons. They can be re-arranged by clicking on the resource, then on the enemy you want it assigned to in the list.
4) The UI is showing you the results of the board layout, so ranged and siege attacks won't go to the ranged phase until you have assigned enough to kill the enemy.
5) All damage defaults to the player, but a target button on the enemy token can be used to assign the damage to a unit(s).
6) "Defender" ability will go to the left most attacked enemy, so move the tokens around to get the defense changed.
This is all Beta and subject to change based on feed back
